chapter: Playing with Punch Miller and touring
title: Chicago dance hall
summary: Morris tries to name the big Chicago hall with lights around the floor; Allen suggests Royal Garden and others.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you ever play in Chicago when you went out there? Yes, we played.

Played at the big hall there, I forget the name of it again. Got lights all around the floor. Oh, it's a big hall. But you don't go play there until 11 o'clock at night. See, people used to start to dance around 8 o'clock, but the dance starts there at 11 o'clock.
Do you remember the name of the place? Would it be like Plantation or the, it wouldn't be Royal Garden, are they?
I think it was the Royal Garden, yes. The headlights all around the floor.
The Dreamland, do you remember that?
I think it was the Royal Garden when we used to play.
The E-Light and Deluxe. The Lickon Garden was another thing that was. Yeah. The Lickon Garden they called it sometimes. Yeah, I... The Deluxe, Entertainers. Yeah, well I...
I just remember the name of it, but I know it was a big hall. And them lights was all around the floor. All up on the music stand.
Might be Lickon Garden or Royal Garden.
Yeah. Well that's why we used to play. Now when you see Punch, maybe he can tell you the name and think of it.
